## Checklist
1. Edit `kubejs/startup_scripts/main.js`
2. In `event.overworld()`, keep only the default overworld deposits you want and choose whether each one is scannable-only or also generated in the world
3. In `event.nether()`, keep only the default nether deposits you want and choose whether each one is scannable-only or also generated in the world
4. Optionally tweak spacing, separation, or salt for the deposits that still generate

Default built-in deposit structure ids can be found in `src/generated/builtin_packs/default/create_rns_dynamic_data/data/create_rns/worldgen/structure`
